name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Higher Education Assurance)
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
description: Financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month for female students who studied in government schools from Class 6 to 12 to pursue higher education.

benefits.summary: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to bank account till completion of degree/diploma.

eligibility_summary: Female students in Tamil Nadu • Studied Class 6-12 in TN Govt schools • Pursuing Degree/Diploma
documents_required: Bank account details linked with Aadhaar

application_process.title: College Portal Registration
application_process.description: Register through the college nodal officer on penkalvi.tn.gov.in portal.

application_process.title: Verify School Records
application_process.description: EMIS portal automatically verifies TN Govt school attendance.

application_process.title: Direct Benefit Credit
application_process.description: ₹1,000 monthly allowance credited automatically every month.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
description: Rights entitlement grant of ₹1,000 monthly for eligible women heads of households in Tamil Nadu to improve livelihood and financial independence.

benefits.summary: ₹1,000 per month credited directly to the woman head of household bank account.

eligibility_summary: Female head of family in Tamil Nadu • Age 21+ • Annual family income below ₹2.5 Lakhs
documents_required: Bank passbook of female head of family

application_process.title: Application at Special Camp
application_process.description: Obtain form at designated ration shop or special e-Sevai camp.

application_process.title: Biometric & Ration Card Verification
application_process.description: Field staff verify family card and electricity bill details.

application_process.title: Monthly Credit
application_process.description: ₹1,000 credited on the 15th of every month.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,500 for eligible women in Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 to promote self-reliance and nutrition.

benefits.summary: ₹1,500 per month financial aid credited to bank account.

eligibility_summary: Women in Maharashtra • Age 21-65 • Annual family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs

application_process.title: Nari Shakti Doot App Application
application_process.description: Download Nari Shakti Doot app or visit nearest Setu Suvidha Kendra.

application_process.title: Upload Domicile & Income
application_process.description: Upload Maharashtra domicile and income proof.
